notes: Game clock feel values. Read by autoload/game_clock.gd. Validate with tools/check_tuning.py.

seconds_per_day_1x.note: GDD 5: one game day per 2 real seconds at 1x.

speed_multipliers.note: GDD 5: 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x. Index 0 is the default speed.

max_days_per_frame.note: Cap on sim days per rendered frame so a long hitch never runs a month in one frame.

pause_on_difficulty_adjustment.note: decisions.md 2026-10-16: about 400 adjustments per campaign, so no auto-pause by default.
